basic_details.offering_entity: National Tsing Hua University (NTHU, Hsinchu, Taiwan / Ministry of Education, Taiwan)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: National Tsing Hua University Main Campus (Hsinchu City, Taiwan - adjacent to Hsinchu Science Park)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all international graduate and undergraduate programs with world-renowned leadership in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (EECS), Semiconductor Technology, Information Systems and Applications, Materials Science and Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Power Mechanical Engineering, and Nuclear Science.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: Approximately 250 to 350 NTHU International Student Scholarships (Type A: Tuition + Monthly Stipend; Type B: Tuition Waiver only) awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani graduates in computer science, electrical engineering, and materials science represent an active cohort (typically 15 to 30 awardees/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for Master degree; up to 4 years for PhD degree, renewed annually based on academic performance and research progress

nationality_requirements: International applicants who do not hold ROC (Taiwan) citizenship or Overseas Chinese student status
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age limit for graduate or undergraduate applicants.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master applicants; Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD applicants with minimum 3.20 / 4.00 CGPA (75%+ aggregate from recognized Pakistani universities like NUST, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, UET, COMSATS, GCU, PIEAS).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Candidates with strong background in mathematics, coding, and laboratory science are prioritized.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Physics, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or Mathematics.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Final year graduating students eligible; must provide official certificate of prospective graduation from home university.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory. Industry engineering experience in semiconductor/embedded systems or software development is valued.

english_proficiency.notes: Official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from Pakistani university widely accepted; IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 79 report accepted for English-taught graduate programs.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Zero Chinese language proficiency required for English-taught graduate programs; free Chinese language courses provided by NTHU Chinese Language Center.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Researchers in semiconductors, microelectronics, computing, and nanosciences.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold full Taiwan MOE / MOFA Scholarship concurrently with NTHU Type A stipend.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver (NTD 60,000 to 75,000 / semester waived completely for all standard degree years).
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~NTD 120,000 to 150,000 / year value; ~PKR 1,050,000 to 1,300,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: NTHU online application fee is NTD 2,000 (for first department) paid by credit card.

accommodation.details: On-campus graduate dormitories guaranteed for international students (double/quad rooms cost ~NTD 10,000 to 15,000/semester; ~PKR 85,000 to 130,000/semester), paid from monthly stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Type A Fellowship provides monthly living stipend: NTD 5,000/month for Master's students (~PKR 44,000/month); NTD 15,000 to 20,000/month for PhD students (~PKR 130,000 to 175,000/month), typically supplemented by professor research assistantships (RA) of NTD 8,000 to 15,000/month in semiconductor and computing labs.
monthly_stipend.amount: NTD 156,000 to 360,000 / year total with RA (~PKR 1,365,000 to 3,150,000 / year)

airfare.details: International airfare between Pakistan and Taipei Taoyuan Airport (TPE) is self-funded by student.

visa_fee.details: Taiwan Resident Visa application fee (~USD 66) paid at Taipei Economic and Cultural Office (TECO).

health_insurance.details: Enrolled in Taiwan National Health Insurance (NHI) after 6 months residency (world-class healthcare at ~NTD 826/month premium); private student insurance covers first 6 months.

food_allowance.details: NTHU campus student cafeterias provide affordable, hygienic meals (~NTD 80 to 120 per meal; ~PKR 700 to 1,050/meal).
food_allowance.amount: Covered from monthly stipend and RA

books_and_materials_allowance.details: State-of-the-art semiconductor cleanrooms, cleanroom wafers, GPU workstations, and lab tools funded by Taiwan National Science and Technology Council (NSTC) and industry grants (TSMC, MediaTek).

research_funding_conference_grant.details: NSTC and NTHU travel subsidies provide up to NTD 60,000 for attending premier international conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Hsinchu city bus (free for students with student card) and Taiwan High Speed Rail (THSR) are self-funded.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single elite research university: National Tsing Hua University (Hsinchu, Taiwan)
participating_institutions: National Tsing Hua University Main Campus (Hsinchu City, Taiwan)
College of Semiconductor Research (Co-founded with TSMC, MediaTek, Novatek)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Ranked top 175 global university (QS World #177), recognized globally as a powerhouse for semiconductors, materials science, and AI computing.
available_majors: College of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science: Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering
College of Semiconductor Research: Semiconductor Device, Circuit and Design, Advanced Packaging
Department of Materials Science and Engineering: Nanotechnology, Functional Materials
Department of Chemical Engineering: Process Engineering, Catalysis
Department of Power Mechanical Engineering: Robotics, Mechatronics
Institute of Information Systems and Applications (IISA)
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master degree: 2 years (4 semesters); PhD degree: 3 to 4 years.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's in STEM with 3.2+ GPA, 2 recommendation letters, study plan/research proposal, CV, and English proficiency certificate (IELTS/TOEFL/MOI).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: College of Semiconductor Research and Computer Science are highly sought after; Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, and Nuclear Science offer favorable admission prospects.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Applying directly for the NTHU scholarship is integrated within the admissions application form - candidates simply check 'Apply for NTHU Scholarship'. Contacting professors in semiconductor and computing labs in advance can secure supplementary Research Assistantship (RA) funding upon arrival.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: NTHU International Graduate Admissions Portal (Office of Global Affairs)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an online application account on the NTHU Office of Global Affairs portal during the open window, complete profile, and select 'NTHU International Student Scholarship' in financial aid section.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - November): Research academic departments and laboratory research on NTHU website; optionally email prospective professors.
Step 2 (October - Mid-January): Create account on NTHU International Graduate Admissions Portal (nthuoga-admission.vm.nthu.edu.tw).
Step 3 (November - January): Fill out online application, select degree program, check 'Yes' to apply for NTHU Scholarship, and upload all required documents.
Step 4 (Mid-January): Pay application fee (NTD 2,000) online via credit card and submit application before deadline.
Step 5 (February - March): Departmental admissions committee reviews applications and recommends scholarship ranking (Type A or Type B) to university scholarship committee.
Step 6 (Mid-April): NTHU announces admissions and scholarship award results on the portal and issues official admission letters.
Step 7 (April - May): Formally accept admission and scholarship offer via online portal.
Step 8 (June - July): Prepare attested educational documents and apply for Taiwan Resident Visa via Taipei Economic and Cultural Office (TECO).
Step 9 (Early September): Arrive at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport, take direct shuttle to NTHU Hsinchu campus, check into dormitories, and complete registration.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated application: Applicants apply for admission and NTHU scholarship simultaneously through the same online admissions portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two recommendation letters submitted online via referee email invitation link generated by NTHU admissions portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Study Plan & Statement of Purpose: Explain academic motivation, research background, study objectives at NTHU, and future career plans (1 to 2 pages).
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured study plan or research proposal (1,000 to 1,500 words) describing research interests, methodology, and relevance to Taiwan's technology ecosystem.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing educational background, GPA, technical skills, programming languages, and research publications.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Interviews are generally NOT required; admission and scholarship decisions are made based on comprehensive document evaluation. Occasional informal video chats may be initiated by individual professors.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 79 recommended; English MOI certificate accepted. GRE not required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Attestation by Higher Education Commission (HEC) and MOFA Pakistan, followed by authentication by Taipei Economic and Cultural Office (TECO).
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: English or Chinese translation required for all official documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via NTHU International Admissions online portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color scan of passport bio-data page valid for at least six months beyond intake date.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure Pakistani machine-readable passport bio page is scanned clearly.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Certified official academic transcripts and degrees covering all university education.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC and MOFA Pakistan; TECO authentication completed prior to visa application.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Structured 1 to 2 page study plan explaining academic background and research goals.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight interest in Taiwan semiconductor or computing technology ecosystem.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Signed recommendation letters from academic professors who know applicant well.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be on institutional letterhead with official institutional email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official bank statement showing minimum USD 4,000 or equivalent balance.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Can be applicant's own account or sponsor/parent account with sponsorship letter.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS, TOEFL scorecard, or English Medium of Instruction certificate.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Official MOI certificate signed by university registrar or controller of examinations.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Academic CV detailing education, publications, software projects, and honors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight papers published in Scopus/WoS indexed journals or conferences.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main Fall intake opens in October with deadline in mid-January. Spring intake (limited programs) runs August to October.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 40% (Undergraduate/Master's GPA, course grades in core engineering and math subjects)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 25% (Prior thesis, publications, lab projects, and semiconductor/coding projects)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Tech industry internships or relevant work experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Quality, clarity, and specificity of Study Plan and research vision)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (Referee appraisals of research acumen and work ethic)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental International Admissions Committee and NTHU University Scholarship Committee.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Single-window evaluation: Departmental admissions committee reviews application dossier, GPA, and study plan. Committee ranks candidates and recommends Type A (Tuition waiver + Monthly stipend) or Type B (Tuition waiver only). Admitted scholars receive scholarship decisions together with admission offers.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,800 to 2,500 international applicants for Fall intake
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~250 to 350 NTHU scholarships (Type A + Type B)
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~24.0% (Very favorable acceptance rate for Pakistani STEM graduates)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Strong foundation in engineering, computing, or physical sciences; clear study plan demonstrating interest in Taiwan tech industry; solid referee support.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from NUST, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, UET, COMSATS, GCU, and PIEAS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, and Materials Science.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand, Malaysia

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized visa agents charging high placement fees for Taiwan university admission. NTHU admissions are handled solely through its official portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: NTHU charges a standard application fee of NTD 2,000 paid securely via online credit card. Never transfer fees to third parties.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: NTHU encourages direct individual application; using agents will not improve selection chances.
hidden_costs_breakdown: International airfare to Taipei Taoyuan (~PKR 180,000 - 260,000 round-trip).
First month living expenses and dorm deposit before first stipend disbursement (~NTD 15,000; ~PKR 130,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: Chinese language ability is required. (FACT: 100% of graduate coursework and research at NTHU can be completed in English).
CLAIM: GRE General score is compulsory. (FACT: GRE is NOT required for NTHU graduate admissions).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some agencies advertise NTHU as covering flights; official university regulations state travel costs are self-funded.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain minimum GPA of 3.0 / 4.0 (or 75% average) each semester to renew scholarship for subsequent terms.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time course enrollment and physical laboratory research residency.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual academic review conducted by department based on semester grades and thesis advisor endorsement.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Students holding an official Taiwan Work Permit (issued via NTHU) may work up to 20 hours per week during semesters and full-time during holidays.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. Graduates are eligible to apply for Taiwan Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) extension for job hunting and qualify for Taiwan employment visas (strong semiconductor recruitment by TSMC, MediaTek, etc.).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is cancelled if GPA drops below requirement or upon withdrawal; past disbursements are not reclaimed.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing majors is permitted within NTHU subject to approval by both departments and the Office of Global Affairs.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarships are granted for standard normative degree duration (2 years MS, 4 years PhD) and cannot be extended beyond maximum limits.
